title: Inline box margins, borders and padding
units: CSS px relative to the container border box; line baseline relative to the line top

f4-single.note: one decorated span on one line

f4-slice.note: a decorated span sliced over three lines
f4-slice.html: a bb cc dd e

f4-edge-width.note: inline-end decoration pushes the next word to the next line

f4-start-width.note: inline-start margin, border, padding take inline space

f4-wider.note: a decorated span wider than the line

f4-nested.note: nested decorated spans sliced over lines
f4-nested.html: a b cc dd e f

f4-vertical-only.note: block-axis padding and border do not change line height
f4-vertical-only.html:
a bb c
d

f4-overlap.note: padding-bottom of a line-1 span overlaps a line-2 span; which background paints on top

f4-overlap-same.note: one span sliced over two lines with padding overlapping its own next fragment
